decisions.reason: This looks like a low-risk relaunch of an already accepted machine ('BASIC 518' to '518 FLEX'), so the option value is high and there is no evidence yet to abandon it.

As a newly launched mobile shredder with its own product page, it still faces unresolved market uncertainty and the firm can afford to keep this option open through its existing mobile-machinery and service network.

The early evidence is limited rather than negative, and for an experienced German machinery maker it is rational to keep a new grinder on the market a bit longer until customer acceptance becomes clearer.

The stationary electric fine shredder fits the firm's strategic move toward tougher and more resource-efficient processing solutions, so without clear failure signals it should be retained as an option.

Although only weakly evidenced so far, this green-waste grinder is a targeted variant in a relevant customer segment, and the firm should preserve the option until demand uncertainty resolves further.
A dedicated product-page launch for stationary single-shaft pre-shredders suggests meaningful commitment and strategic fit, and there is no sign yet that the product's value will not materialize.
